title: ESPN Scraper Input
description: Pull ESPN scores, game details, standings, teams, players, news, schedules, rankings and odds for 36 leagues — no key, cookie or proxy.

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Scoreboard — games, matches, leaderboards and fight cards
Game Detail — box score, player lines, odds and win probability
Standings — league tables plus F1 drivers and constructors
Teams — every team in a league
Team Detail — record, venue and next event for selected teams
News — league headlines or the global ESPN feed
Players — rosters, athlete search, profiles, stats and game logs
Schedule — a team's season schedule with results
Rankings — ATP, WTA, UFC and college polls
Odds — primary sportsbook line per game

league.title: League
league.description: League slug. The sport is derived automatically.

leagues.title: Extra leagues
leagues.description: Optional multi-league override for modes that iterate leagues (scoreboard, odds, standings, teams, teamDetail, news, players, schedule, rankings), e.g. ["nba","nfl"].

datePreset.title: Date preset
datePreset.description: Date window for scoreboard and odds. ESPN accepts one date per request, so ranges are fetched one day at a time.

startDate.title: Start date (custom)
startDate.description: First date for datePreset=custom, in YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.title: End date (custom)
endDate.description: Last date for datePreset=custom (inclusive), in YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD. Maximum 366 days.

season.title: Season year
season.description: ESPN season year for standings, schedule, players and rankings (e.g. 2025). Leave blank for the current season.

seasonType.title: Season type (mode=schedule)
seasonType.description: Filter a team schedule by season phase (ignored for soccer schedules, which ESPN reports as one league season).

teamIds.title: Team IDs or abbreviations
teamIds.description: Teams for teams/teamDetail/schedule/players. Accepts 2, BOS or nba/BOS. Get IDs from mode=teams.

eventIds.title: Event IDs
eventIds.description: Games for gameDetail/odds. Accepts 401909904 or nba/401909904. Get IDs from mode=scoreboard.

athleteQueries.title: Athlete searches (mode=players)
athleteQueries.description: Player names to search, e.g. ["LeBron James", "Jannik Sinner"].

athleteIds.title: Athlete IDs (mode=players)
athleteIds.description: ESPN athlete IDs for direct profiles, e.g. ["1966"].

rankingType.title: Ranking (mode=rankings)
rankingType.description: Which poll to return. 'all' includes every poll ESPN publishes for the league.

statusFilter.title: Game status
statusFilter.description: Filter scoreboard, odds or schedule rows by game state.

liveOnly.title: Live only
liveOnly.description: Keep only in-progress games (scoreboard and odds).

newsScope.title: News scope (mode=news)
newsScope.description: League news is capped at 50 articles by ESPN. Global pages the ESPN now feed and filters to the selected league.

includeTeamDetails.title: Include team details (mode=teams)
includeTeamDetails.description: Fetch each team's record, venue and next event. Adds one request per team.

includeGameDetails.title: Include game details (mode=scoreboard)
includeGameDetails.description: Attach the full game summary to every team-sport game. Adds one request per game.

includePlayerStats.title: Include player stats
includePlayerStats.description: Attach latest season stats to player rows and the player box score to gameDetail. Adds requests per player.

includeGameLog.title: Include game log (mode=players)
includeGameLog.description: Attach the current-season game log to each player. Adds one request per athlete.

includePlayByPlay.title: Include every play
includePlayByPlay.description: Include the full play-by-play list in gameDetail (scoring plays are always included).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on data records. Notice rows explain unsupported or empty requests.
